sloka: ततः सहस्रं भेरीणां युगपत् समहन्यत ।मृष्टकाञ्चनकोणानामासक्तानां समन्ततः ।। ६.६०.४९ ।।।।
transliteration: tataḥ sahasraṁ bherīṇāṁ yugapat samahanyata ।mṛṣṭakāñcanakoṇānāmāsaktānāṁ samantataḥ ।। 6.60.49 ।।।।

translations.english: All the Rakshasas endowed with mighty prowess became enraged and others started to arouse with all their strength.
